## Ringkasan

Vendor mengunggah file DSR harian di VendorPortal. Upload dua tahap: dry-run (validasi, tampil pratinjau) lalu confirm (simpan). Parsing dilakukan ETL Python, idempoten per hash file. Batas upload 09:00.

- `/dsr`: _tanpa role guard_ ([`dsr.tsx`](../../frontend/VendorPortal-Vite/src/routes/dsr.tsx))
